items.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: We did, the trumpet kings, in the studio, and then he did it again in Montreux. He had Clark Terry, Dizzy, right, and Roy...

ctx.x: Norman Granz had the facility to listen to various players and pair them. And in some cases pit them one against the other. You know he’d, I remember we were listening to one player, I won’t call any names, we were listening to one person play and he’d say, “boy he can play. I’d like to hear him with Little Jazz” you know, Roy Eldridge.
